sourceHtml:
Agents are only as useful as what they know, and only as trustworthy as the boundaries they run within. 

Leading enterprises are using the open source NVIDIA Agent Toolkit — now expanded with new tools — to customize and control agents, use company data to inform their answers and actions, monitor what they do and govern how they operate. 

NVIDIA Agent Toolkit comprises:

  • The new NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation with NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries
  • NVIDIA open models including Nemotron Retriever and the new Kumo family
  • NVIDIA OpenShell secure agent runtime
  • NVIDIA NemoClaw secure agent blueprints
  • Tools and skills, like NeMo Relay and NeMo Compass 

To develop agents that accomplish real work and are trustworthy from development to deployment, builders need an open agent stack that brings together the models, harness, runtime, data and tools.

NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation helps enterprises turn data into company intelligence agents can use. Agents can find relevant information, understand what it means for the business and use it to make predictions and help people decide what to do next. Companies can use Agent Knowledge Foundation without moving data, rebuilding existing workflows or changing governance controls. 

The foundation features NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuDF, cuGraph, cuML, cuOpt and cuVS, and the new Auto-Ontology library, which translates raw company data into familiar business concepts — like customers, products and orders — and maps how they relate. 

It also includes NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever and Kumo Structured open models — Kumo Tabular, Kumo Relational, Kumo Time Series and Kumo Forecast — which help agents find relevant company information to answer questions and make predictions. 

OpenShell provides the secure runtime boundary, giving enterprises control over what agents can access and do. NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints provide reference designs for building secure, specialized agents. The newest NemoClaw blueprint for agent optimization provides a step-by-step starting point for improving agent intelligence — making them better at their jobs over time.

Enterprises Adopt NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation

The new NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation is already at work across enterprises.

With Palantir, NVIDIA’s supply chain organization is using Agent Knowledge Foundation through Palantir Foundry, Ontology and AIP to deploy specialized agents, create actionable intelligence from proprietary data, predict outcomes and optimize decision-making.

Databricks pairs NVIDIA Kumo Anomaly with Databricks Genie Ontology to power context-aware agents.

Snowflake is enabling customers to use the NVIDIA Kumo Engine and Kumo Relational open models in their Snowflake Notebook environments to unlock more predictive capabilities.

NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models make search faster and more accurate. Using the embedding model, Amazon OpenSearch Service improved relevance with fewer search steps and virtually no added latency. SAP’s fine-tuned reranker ran nearly 3x faster. ServiceNow improved reranking quality while cutting latency by nearly a quarter. Zoom is using Nemotron Retriever models to improve document understanding, search relevance and context retrieval for Zoom AI Services. 

Amazon Web Services (AWS), ClickHouse, Cloudera, Cohesity, Dassault Systèmes, Dell, Elastic, Exa, IBM, NetApp, Oracle, Perplexity, Starburst and VAST Data are also among those building on Agent Knowledge Foundation. 

Learn more by joining this GTC Berlin session on building, deploying and optimizing specialized agents in production.

translation.html:
智能体的实用性取决于它们掌握的知识，而可信度则取决于其运行时所受的边界约束。 

领先企业正在使用开源的 NVIDIA Agent Toolkit（现已扩展并加入新工具）来定制和控制智能体，利用公司数据为智能体的回答和行动提供依据，监控其行为并管理其运行方式。 

NVIDIA Agent Toolkit 包括：

  • 全新的 NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation，配备 NVIDIA CUDA-X 库
  • NVIDIA 开放模型，包括 Nemotron Retriever 和全新的 Kumo 系列
  • NVIDIA OpenShell 安全智能体运行时
  • NVIDIA NemoClaw 安全智能体蓝图
  • 工具和技能，例如 NeMo Relay 和 NeMo Compass 

要开发能够完成实际工作、并从开发到部署都值得信赖的智能体，开发者需要一个将模型、执行框架、运行时、数据和工具整合在一起的开放智能体技术栈。

NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation 帮助企业将数据转化为智能体可用的公司业务情报。智能体可以查找相关信息，理解这些信息对业务的意义，并据此进行预测，帮助人们决定下一步行动。公司无需迁移数据、重建现有工作流程或更改治理控制措施，即可使用 Agent Knowledge Foundation。 

该基础平台配备 NVIDIA CUDA-X 库，包括 cuDF、cuGraph、cuML、cuOpt 和 cuVS，以及全新的 Auto-Ontology 库。该库可将公司的原始数据转化为客户、产品和订单等熟悉的业务概念，并映射它们之间的关系。 

它还包括 NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever 和 Kumo Structured 开放模型——Kumo Tabular、Kumo Relational、Kumo Time Series 和 Kumo Forecast，帮助智能体查找相关公司信息，以回答问题并进行预测。 

OpenShell 提供安全的运行时边界，让企业能够控制智能体可以访问的资源和执行的操作。NVIDIA NemoClaw 蓝图为构建安全的专用智能体提供参考设计。最新的智能体优化 NemoClaw 蓝图提供循序渐进的起步指南，用于提升智能体的智能水平，使它们随着时间推移更好地完成工作。

企业采用 NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation

全新的 NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation 已在多家企业投入使用。

通过与 Palantir 合作，NVIDIA 供应链部门正在通过 Palantir Foundry、Ontology 和 AIP 使用 Agent Knowledge Foundation，以部署专用智能体、将专有数据转化为可指导行动的情报、预测结果并优化决策。

Databricks 将 NVIDIA Kumo Anomaly 与 Databricks Genie Ontology 相结合，为能够感知上下文的智能体提供支持。

Snowflake 正在让客户能够在其 Snowflake Notebook 环境中使用 NVIDIA Kumo Engine 和 Kumo Relational 开放模型，以解锁更多预测能力。

NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever 模型让搜索更快、更准确。通过使用嵌入模型，Amazon OpenSearch Service 以更少的搜索步骤提升了相关性，而且几乎没有增加延迟。SAP 的 微调重排序模型运行速度达到原来的近 3 倍。ServiceNow 提升了重排序质量，同时将延迟降低了近四分之一。Zoom 正在使用 Nemotron Retriever 模型，改善 Zoom AI Services 的文档理解、搜索相关性和上下文检索。 

Amazon Web Services（AWS）、ClickHouse、Cloudera、Cohesity、Dassault Systèmes、Dell、 Elastic、Exa、IBM、NetApp、Oracle、Perplexity、Starburst 和 VAST Data 等也正在基于 Agent Knowledge Foundation 进行构建。 

参加这场 GTC 柏林会议，了解如何在生产环境中构建、部署和优化专用智能体，获取更多信息。
